title: Approvals inbox: the status filter has no Cancelled option, although the list shows cancelled requests
body:
## What happens

In the approvals inbox, on the **My requests** and **All** tabs, the status filter lists five statuses: Pending, Approved, Rejected, Recalled, Returned for revision. A request can also be **Cancelled** (the terminal state added by #13568), and such a request is shown in the list with its own badge — but the filter has no Cancelled entry, so cancelled requests cannot be filtered for.

Seen on `@objectstack/*` 18.6.0 (HotCRM 6.6.0, zh-CN UI); the select is the same on `main`.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Have a request whose status is `cancelled` (in my run: an expense report under approval was deleted by an admin; its request shows "related record deleted" and the Cancelled badge).
2. Open `/_console/apps/<app>/component/approvals/inbox`, tab **All**. The cancelled request is in the list.
3. Open the status filter.

**Actual:** the options are All statuses / Pending / Approved / Rejected / Recalled / Returned for revision. There is no Cancelled.

**Expected:** every status a row can show is offered by the filter, Cancelled included. The server already accepts it: `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?status=cancelled` answers the cancelled rows.

## Why

`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` on `main`, lines 1839–1852:

```tsx
<SelectContent>
  <SelectItem value="all">{tr('allStatuses', 'All statuses')}</SelectItem>
  <SelectItem value="pending">{statusLabel('pending')}</SelectItem>
  <SelectItem value="approved">{statusLabel('approved')}</SelectItem>
  <SelectItem value="rejected">{statusLabel('rejected')}</SelectItem>
  <SelectItem value="recalled">{statusLabel('recalled')}</SelectItem>
  <SelectItem value="returned">{statusLabel('returned')}</SelectItem>
</SelectContent>
```

`statusLabel` (line 874) and `STATUS_CLASSES` (line 131) both already know `cancelled`, and the locale files carry `statusCancelled`; only the select was not extended when the state was added.

## Impact

A submitter or an admin looking for the requests that ended without a decision (record deleted, process cancelled) has to scroll the whole list; with more than one page loaded on demand they may not find them at all.

## Related

- #30525 (closed) covered the docs page omitting `cancelled` and a refusal text, not this select.
